dedupe_keys.name: photovoltaic maximum power point tracking replication model

description: This replication model supports comparisons of sequential Monte Carlo, perturb-and-observe and other maximum-power-point tracking methods for photovoltaic arrays. Al al-Bayt University researchers publish a Simulink model, MATLAB functions and MAT inputs alongside diagrams and recorded results. The cases include static and dynamic partial shading with changing irradiance and temperature. Mendeley version 2 provides the collection free under CC BY 4.0, while running it requires a compatible MATLAB/Simulink installation with its own licence conditions. Coverage is simulated array and controller configurations, not a geographic monitoring record or a common observation period. The repository description mentions experimental Excel files, but none appears in the current file-name inventory, so their availability remains unverified. A reviewer-assessed use is reproducing controller responses or benchmarking alternative tracking methods in photovoltaic simulations. model-system-advisor-model-sam supplies related system-performance modelling at another level. No model archive, source file or simulation output was executed.
inputs: Irradiance, temperature and static or dynamic partial-shading cases
name: Photovoltaic maximum-power-point tracking replication model
